why_committed: Force-added past /data/ in .gitignore, the same deliberate exception the snapshot manifests use. fetch_obscodes() returns this cached copy when present, which is what lets the submission watch run on a GitHub runner where the MPC is unreachable (see .github/workflows/itf-snapshot.yml). Observatory longitudes define the local-night boundary used by every sweep, so this file is also the reason 'night' means the same thing in the queue and in the watcher.
cached_locally: 2026-08-16 or earlier; refresh with fetch_obscodes(force=True) from a residential connection
